Beginner.learningGoal: Pass behaviour around with Func, Action and lambdas.
gotchas: Func<T> last type argument is the return type
A lambda capturing a loop variable from a for loop
goodSolutionShows: Small composable functions passed as arguments
shapeHints: filtering notifications with a configurable rule
a retry helper taking an Action

Intermediate.learningGoal: Raise and subscribe to events safely, and compose delegates.
gotchas: Raising an event without a null check (use ?.Invoke)
Subscribers that are never removed keep publishers alive
Multicast delegates return only the last result
goodSolutionShows: Thread-safe raise by copying the delegate

Advanced.learningGoal: Use closures and higher-order functions deliberately, aware of allocations.
gotchas: Closures allocate a display class per capture scope
Exceptions in one event handler stop the rest
goodSolutionShows: static lambdas where nothing should be captured
Handlers invoked individually with error isolation
